title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
tagline: Steal the plans. Share the snacks.
about: A band of rebels sets out to steal the plans for the Death Star.

No complaints to the cook. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Laser issue, fleet standard. Form G-16, sheet 2 of 2. 2016. Crew notes: Jyn Erso and the Death Star plans. Rebellions are built on hope. K-2SO the droid.

Rogue One GalleyRogue One: A Star Wars StorySteal the plans. Share the snacks.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersZa'atar flatbreads with hummusGrilled za'atar flatbreads with hummus, pickled turnips and olivesHow to make it4 flatbreads3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil3 tbsp za'atar200g hummus100g pickled turnips100g kalamata olivesBrush the flatbreads with oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar.Grill until blistered at the edges. Cut into wedges.Serve with hummus, pickled turnips and olives in little bowls.Scarif beach prawnsGarlic chilli lime prawns grilled on skewers, with mango coriander salsaHow to make it600g peeled green prawns3 garlic cloves, crushed1 red chilli, chopped2 limes, one juiced and one for salsa1 mango, diced2 tbsp chopped corianderToss the prawns with the garlic, chilli and juice of 1 lime. Marinate for 20 minutes.Dice the mango and mix with coriander and the juice of the second lime for the salsa.Thread the prawns onto skewers and grill until pink and charred. Serve with the salsa.MainsJedha spiced lamb pilafLamb, carrots and basmati rice cooked with cumin and cinnamonHow to make it600g lamb, diced2 tbsp oil1 brown onion, sliced2 carrots, cut into strips1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp ground cinnamon300g basmati rice, rinsed600ml chicken stock50g flaked almonds50g raisins200g Greek yoghurt1 garlic clove, crushedBrown the lamb in the oil. Add the onion, carrots, cumin and cinnamon and cook 5 minutes.Stir in the rice and stock, cover and cook on low.Rest the pilaf, covered, for 10 minutes. Toast the almonds meanwhile.Pile onto a platter with the raisins and almonds. Serve with yoghurt mixed with the garlic.Yavin 4 rebel base chicken rice bowlsThe rebel base on Yavin 4 where Rogue One gets its call signHow to make itAs written, serves 4Smoky paprika and garlic chicken charred on the grill, sliced over rice with black beans, charred corn, avocado, pickled onion and lime crema.Rub 800g chicken thighs with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt.Cook 300g rice.Slice a red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt.Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels.Warm a drained can of black beans with cumin.Grill the chicken 5 minutes a side and slice.Build bowls with avocado, pickled onion and sour cream mixed with lime.SweetsDeath Star plans chocolate sphereDark glazed chocolate mousse spheres. What is it they've sent us? Hope.How to make it150g dark chocolate, for the mousse100g dark chocolate, for the glaze2 eggs, separated40g caster sugar150ml cream, whipped, for the mousse100ml thickened cream, for the glaze1 tbsp cocoaSeparate the eggs. Melt the mousse chocolate and whisk in the yolks. Whip the whites with the sugar and fold in with the whipped cream.Spoon into 4 round moulds and set overnight.Melt the glaze chocolate with the thickened cream and cocoa. Turn out the spheres and glaze them. Press a dent in each.DrinksChirrut's teaGreen tea with ginger and honey, hot or iced, for a Guardian of the WhillsHow to make it4 tsp green tea leaves1 knob ginger, sliced1 L water, about 80C2 tbsp honeySteep the green tea and ginger in the hot water for 3 minutes.Strain and stir in the honey.Serve hot in small cups, or chill and pour over ice.
